acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Peptides were separated using a Thermo Scientific Easy-nLC 1000 system coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer operating in data-dependent acquisition mode.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were first treated with PNGase F for deglycosylation, then denatured in urea and reduced with TCEP before alkylation with 2-chloroacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested overnight with trypsin, acidified, and desalted on C18 columns.

collision_energy.evidence: Full MS scans were acquired at high resolution in the Orbitrap, and the top 10 ions were selected for higher-energy collision dissociation fragmentation.
